description: This file defines a ValidatorFactory class responsible for creating validation closures using Symfony's Validator component. It provides methods to generate closures that validate single values or iterators/arrays against specific constraints.

classes.name: ValidatorFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating closure-based validators utilizing Symfony's Validator component.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects a ValidatorInterface instance.

methods.name: createClosure
methods.description: Creates a closure that validates a single value against provided constraints.

methods.name: createClosureForIterator
methods.description: Creates a closure that validates each element in an array or iterator against provided constraints.
